name: Sanrhea Technical Textiles Limited
about: Sanrhea Technical Textiles Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial fabrics in India and internationally. The company provides RFL-dipped fabrics for tires, conveyor belts, and other rubber products; chafer fabrics for tires; liners fabrics; woven fabrics; diaphragm, impression, and float fabrics; and warp-sheet and stretch fabrics for transmission belts, hose pipes, air springs, special marine inflatables, and tire patches. Sanrhea Technical Textiles Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Kalol, India.
